This so-called "cleanser" is a creamy, oily mixture that was separated in the bottle. I had to shake it up to get it to blend. But then, putting it on my face, I felt like I was smearing oil all over my skin. It was so gross I immediately washed it off with a regular facial cleanser. I don't understand why companies are making these "oil" cleansers lately, when for centuries, soap--which is made with oil plus an alkaline compound that work like magic together to remove impurities--has worked great. This is the perfect example imo of why you shouldn't try to fix something that isn't broken. I'm glad I got this for free, because I threw it in the trash. Literally if I wanted to, I could get the same effect from rubbing vegetable oil on my skin.

avis.titre: Gentle Balm Cleanser That Melts Away Makeup
avis.texte: gifted by theinkeylist. The The Inkey List Oat Cleansing Balm is a gentle yet effective cleanser that effortlessly removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup without stripping the skin. The rich balm texture melts into the skin, breaking down impurities while leaving your face feeling soft and nourished. Formulated with colloidal oatmeal, it helps soothe and calm the skin, making it an excellent choice for sensitive, dry, or irritated skin types. It also provides hydration while cleansing, so your skin feels comfortable and balanced after rinsing rather than tight or dry. The balm emulsifies well and works beautifully as the first step in a double-cleansing routine. It removes even stubborn makeup while helping maintain the skin's moisture barrier. While the texture can feel thicker than some cleansing balms, it does an excellent job of leaving skin clean, smooth, and refreshed.

I used this to take of my waterproof mascara and my makeup after a long day as my first step in double cleansing my skin. This is really nice. It says it's a new formula but I can't tell a different between the old and new version. But I definitely do like this for removing my stubborn makeup. complimentary from The INKEY List

complimentary from theinkeylist! This is one of my favorite cleansing balms! A little bit goes a long way! It doesn't strip my face of all of my natural oils, but instead leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. I love that they reformulated it.
